architecture/florence/battistero.webp.description: The Baptistery of San Giovanni in Florence: an octagonal building with green and white marble bands and a small lantern on top of its dome, drawn whole from the ground to the tip of the lantern.

architecture/florence/casa-torre.webp.description: A medieval Florentine tower house: a tall square stone tower with a wooden balcony high up, drawn whole from the ground to the top of its battlements.

architecture/florence/chiesa-romanica.we.description: A Romanesque church facade with a round rose window, arched doorway and small bell turret, drawn whole from the ground to the top of the gable.

architecture/florence/porta-citta.webp.description: A medieval city gate: a square crenellated stone tower with a tall archway through it and a stretch of crenellated town wall, drawn from the ground to the top of the tower.

figures/citizens/frate.webp.description: A friar in a brown habit with a knotted rope belt and sandals, standing, hands together.

figures/citizens/scriba.webp.description: A scribe standing at a tall wooden writing desk, writing with a quill; the figure's head is the highest point.

figures/citizens/donna-fiorentina.webp.description: A Florentine woman in a long dress and blue veil, standing, carrying a basket.

figures/citizens/mercante.webp.description: A merchant in a long light tunic with a belt purse, standing, one hand out.

figures/dante/beatrice.webp.description: Beatrice, a young Florentine woman in a long white gown and veil, standing.

figures/dante/dante-cavaliere.webp.description: Dante as a young cavalryman in chain mail and a red surcoat, riding a saddled horse; the rider's head is the highest point.

figures/dante/dante-esule.webp.description: Dante in exile: an older man in a red hooded robe with a walking staff and a shoulder bag, standing.

figures/dante/dante-scrive.webp.description: Dante seated on a wooden chair, writing in a book on his lap; figure and chair are one drawing, his head is the highest point.

figures/dante/dante-cammina.webp.description: Dante walking with a staff, in a red robe and white cap, a bag at his side.

figures/dante/dante-legge.webp.description: Dante standing in a long red robe and red cap, reading a book held in both hands.

figures/dante/guido-cavalcanti.webp.description: Guido Cavalcanti, a young Florentine nobleman in a short red tunic, cloak and hose, standing, holding a scroll.

figures/dante/dante-giovane.webp.description: Young Dante in a red robe reading a book, drawn from the knees up (the lower legs and feet are cut off).

figures/power/messo.webp.description: A messenger in a short tunic with a satchel, standing, holding a sealed letter.

figures/power/priore.webp.description: A prior, a Florentine city magistrate, in a long red gown with a blue collar and black cap, standing, reading a document.

figures/power/virgilio.webp.description: Virgil, the Roman poet, in a white toga with a laurel wreath, standing, one hand raised.

figures/power/papa-bonifacio.webp.description: Pope Boniface VIII standing in papal vestments and a tall papal tiara, raising a hand in blessing; the top of the tiara is the highest point.

figures/soldiers/cavaliere-guelfo.webp.description: A Guelph knight in a great helm and a white surcoat with a red cross, on a white horse, holding a lance upright; the lance tip is the highest point.

figures/soldiers/fante.webp.description: A foot soldier in a padded coat and kettle helmet, standing, holding an upright spear and a painted shield; the spear tip is the highest point.

figures/soldiers/cavallo.webp.description: A saddled riding horse without a rider, standing, head up; the top of the head is the highest point.

figures/soldiers/balestriere.webp.description: A crossbowman kneeling on one knee, aiming a crossbow, in a quilted coat and kettle helmet.

nature/tuscany/erba.webp.description: A tuft of wild grass with a few poppies and daisies.

nature/tuscany/quercia.webp.description: A broad oak tree with a spreading crown.

nature/tuscany/ulivo.webp.description: An olive tree with a twisted trunk and a silvery crown.

nature/tuscany/cipresso.webp.description: An Italian cypress: a tall narrow evergreen.

nature/tuscany/nuvola-2.webp.description: A puffy cumulus cloud tinted pink and yellow.

nature/tuscany/stormo.webp.description: A small flock of birds in flight.

props/medieval/lanterna.webp.description: An iron hand lantern with glass panes, a lit candle inside and a ring handle on top, standing upright.

props/medieval/bisaccia.webp.description: A leather satchel with two buckled straps and a shoulder strap, standing upright.

props/medieval/stendardo.webp.description: A war banner: a white cloth with a red cross hanging from a crossbar with a spear-point finial, on a short piece of pole.

props/medieval/fiorino.webp.description: A gold florin coin with the Florentine lily, drawn large as a close-up.

props/medieval/corona-alloro.webp.description: A laurel wreath, drawn as a close-up.

props/medieval/codice-aperto.webp.description: An open manuscript book with handwritten pages, drawn as a close-up.

props/medieval/pergamena-sigillata.webp.description: A rolled parchment tied with cord and a red wax seal, drawn as a close-up.

props/medieval/penna-calamaio.webp.description: A goose-feather quill standing in a glass inkwell, drawn as a close-up.

props/medieval/bastone.webp.description: A plain wooden walking staff drawn lying diagonally, as a close-up.
